decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The work to which this consent relates shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - All new and external and internal works and finishes and works of making good shall match the existing original work adjacent in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance, except where indicated otherwise on the drawings hereby approved or as required by any conditions attached to this consent.

Condition : 3 - Before commencement of the work authorised by this consent, a plan of the building drawn to an appropriate scale and marked up to show the extent of the proposed works shall be submtted to the Council and to the Secretary of State for approval (in consulation with English Heritage).
description: Repairs to conservatory - Chiswick House ( Listed Building).
